description: Construction number 9452. Esri WorldView-2 imagery of 3 June 2022 shows a complete, intact, all-white DC-3 standing alone on mown grass inside the N'Dolo perimeter, roughly 150 m clear of the general-aviation apron, with a footpath running to it and a low white structure alongside - a placed display rather than a parked or abandoned machine. A contributor notes the aircraft carries four-bladed propellers and doubts the engines are original R-1830s, which suggests the airframe has been cosmetically made up rather than left as retired. Caution on identity: the registration 9Q-CTR is also carried on the N'Djili boneyard listing by a dumped An-24RV, construction number 77310802, so the mark has been re-issued or mis-recorded somewhere on the Congolese register; the construction number is the firmer identifier here.
